title: fix(fields): the editable date-only faces name a stored impossible day instead of blanking it silently (objectui#10567)
body:
Fixes #10567
Clause-②: no

## What changed

This is the date-only half of objectui#10474 (PR objectui#10566), with the same face.

- The editable `DateField` and the sub-grid's editable `date` cell in `GridField` now check a stored value with `isImpossibleStoredDay`, which objectui#10566 added to `packages/fields/src/widgets/nativeDateValue.ts`. There is no second predicate, and `nativeDateValue.ts` is not edited.
- For a day that does not exist, both faces hand the control an empty value, mark it `aria-invalid`, and show a notice that names the stored string. The control's `aria-describedby` points at the notice, and a host's own `aria-describedby` is kept in front of the notice id. Examples: `2026-02-30`, `2024-02-31`, `2025-02-29`, and the ISO spelling `2026-02-30T00:00:00.000Z` that an API may hand back.
- Nothing is written until the user picks a new day. Picking a real day writes it and clears the marker and the notice.
- Real days and empty values render as before. There is no notice and no `aria-describedby`, and `aria-invalid` is unchanged (`false` on `DateField`, absent on the grid cell).
- New i18n key `fields.date.impossibleDay`, in all ten packs plus `FIELD_DEFAULTS`: `The stored value "VALUE" is not a real date. Pick a date to replace it.` The existing `fields.dateTime.impossibleDay` asks the user to pick "a date and time", which does not fit a date-only control, so it is not reused. The grid cell picks the key by column type.
- The `de` quote-pairing ratchet goes from 64 to 65 for the new German value (one more matched „…“ span), with a rationale line, the same way objectui#10566 moved it.
- `toDateInputValue` is unchanged. It still returns the leading day verbatim, which the objectui#10474 pin keeps. The widget hands the control the empty value, not the adapter.

### Why the control is handed an empty value explicitly

The browser would paint it empty anyway. Handing it the empty value keeps the markup honest. Before this change the rendered `value` attribute held `2026-02-30` while the control read back empty. That attribute-versus-property split is the one `nativeDateValue.ts` documents for objectui#3127. It also matches the date-time face, whose adapter already hands the control an empty value.

## Measurements (the dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

1. **Chromium 141.0.7390.37** (playwright-core 1.62.1, `executablePath` `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`), re-run by this dev because the card relayed it unrun. An `input type=date` set to `2026-02-30` or `2025-02-29` reads back empty, while `2026-02-28` and `2024-02-29` read back as set. A control whose `value` attribute is `2026-02-30` reads back empty with `validity.valid` true, so the browser raises no invalid state by itself.
2. **happy-dom 20.11.2** (the `dom` test project's environment) sanitises the same way on the property path: set to `2026-02-30`, it reads back empty, while the attribute keeps the string. On the unfixed tree the pin's empty-control assertion held and the first red was the missing marker. So the pin asserts what the component renders (the marker, the notice and its link), and the empty control holds in both environments.
3. **Read-only faces, left alone.** The readonly `DateField` renders the shared `EmptyValue` affordance for an impossible day, byte-identical to what it renders for `not-a-date`. That is objectui#10026 ruling A's marker, pinned by `date-carriers.impossibleDay-10026.test.tsx` (green in this run). It neither rolls the day nor shows the stored string. The grid's read-only date text shows the raw stored string (objectui#3569). Neither face changes here.

## Pins (`DateField.impossibleDay-10567.test.tsx`, 18 tests)

- `DateField`, four impossible spellings: the control is empty, `aria-invalid` is `true`, and the notice names the stored string and is linked through `aria-describedby`. No rolled day appears anywhere, and a blur with no edit writes nothing. A host `aria-describedby` is kept. Picking `2026-02-28` writes it and clears the marker and the notice.
- The grid's `date` cell: the same four spellings and the same checks. Picking a real day writes it and clears the marker and the notice.
- Controls: the real days `2026-02-28` and `2024-02-29` (a leap day), and empty values (empty string, undefined, an empty cell), give no marker, no notice and no `aria-describedby`.

Directions predicted before the runs: the unfixed tree gives 11 red and 7 green. The ablation gives the same, with the objectui#10474 pin fully green.

- **Unfixed tree** (base `21d34d5e2`): 11 failed, 7 passed. Every failure is a marker assertion.
- **Reverse verification**, with the fix committed first, at head `b78821cd6`. objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` turned `const impossible = isImpossibleStoredDay(value);` into `const impossible = false;` in `DateField.tsx`. It also dropped the `date` arm of the grid's check (`(c.type === 'date' || c.type === 'datetime') && ...` became `c.type === 'datetime' && ...`). That restores the pre-card behaviour of both faces. On disk, the anchors went from 1 to 0, the replacements from 0 to 1, and both blobs changed. Result: 11 failed, 29 passed. Every impossible-day row went red, the 7 controls stayed green, and the 22 tests of `DateTimeField.impossibleDay-10474.test.tsx` stayed green. Both files were restored: each blob equals HEAD's and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No build was involved, because the pin imports the widgets by relative path.

## Gates (head `b78821cd6`)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/ packages/i18n/` from the repo root: 275 files passed, 1 skipped; 4543 tests passed, 7 skipped.
- Built the `@object-ui/fields` dependency closure (`pnpm --filter '@object-ui/fields^...' build`, exit 0), then ran `type-check` for `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/i18n`: both `Done`, exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the new pin.
- Exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-dead-keys` (the new key is not listed), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`. My own control-byte scan over the changed files found 0 hits.
- `check:changeset-claims` names three pending changesets that mention a touched file: 6625 (`GridField.tsx`), 6661 (`en.ts`) and 7122 (`useFieldTranslation.ts`). I read all three paragraphs. None is about the lines this PR changes, and all three still hold.
- ESLint `--no-inline-config` over the 15 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files. The file count comes from eslint's own JSON output: 15 at head, 14 at base because the pin is new. Errors are 0 at base and at head. Per rule, base vs head: `no-explicit-any` goes from 16 to 18 (both in the new pin: the empty `field` fixture and the grid column fixture), and every other rule is unchanged. The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads a built console bundle). Left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Two sibling editors outside this card's file surface have the same class of defect. They are reported to the seat, not changed here:
  - `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `InlineFieldInput`: its native date branch serves both `date` and `datetime` fields and slices the stored value to its leading day. Probe (happy-dom render, not committed): a stored `2026-02-30`, or `2026-02-30T10:00:00Z` on a `datetime` field, gives an `input type=date` whose value reads back empty while the attribute holds `2026-02-30`, with no `aria-invalid` and no notice. That is this card's silent blank.
  - `@object-ui/components` data-table inline cell editor (`data-table.tsx`) keeps its own private copies of the two adapters. Its `datetime` copy goes straight to the engine, so `2026-02-30T10:00:00Z` shows as `2026-03-02T10:00` in UTC (engine probe of the same expression), which is the objectui#10474 roll. Its `date` copy has this card's silent blank. Read at source, not rendered.
- The notice wording is a new sentence and is not pinned. Only the stored string it names is asserted.
- The widget was not rendered in a real browser. The Chromium reading is on a raw control. happy-dom agrees with it on the property path.

Implemented by the `domain:ui#1` seat, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC` (dispatched subagent).
